# Your own QField project

#### Learning Objective {-}

- Create a QField survey for your own plot  

&nbsp;

QField is a really great tool for collecting data, but it is only useful if you can use it for your own data collection. Now that you have followed the previous modules, you are now ready to create your own QField project for your own plot using a geopackage that has been prepared for you.

If you do not have the geopackage, please contact the relevant ForestPlots contact to help you generate this.
